title: Clay Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clay:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often clay metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on clay metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how often your clay metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
